name: The Peninsula Bangkok
positioning: Peninsula hotel on the Chao Phraya River in Klongsan, Bangkok, where every room and suite opens to the river and rooms are finished in teak and silk
best_for: Travelers who want river views and hotel boats to the BTS Skytrain and ICONSIAM
Guests interested in arriving by helicopter at the hotel's private helipad
Spa-goers wanting a riverside spa with sauna, steam room and plunge pools
Food lovers interested in Thai cuisine and Thai cooking demonstrations

facts.text: The hotel is at 333 Charoennakorn Road, Klongsan, Bangkok.
The hotel is 39 km from Suvarnabhumi Airport and 33 km from Don Muang Airport.
Every room and suite opens to the Chao Phraya River.
Rooms are finished with polished teak and silks.
The 36th-floor Thai Suite is designed around the concept of a traditional Thai luxury home.
The Terrace Suite on the 37th floor has a landscaped terrace with teak decking, sun loungers, a dining area and an outdoor whirlpool.
Thiptara's menu is led by Chef Luk.
Peninsula Bangkok chefs give step-by-step Thai cooking demonstrations.
Dining includes Peninsula Afternoon Tea, Thai cuisine and riverside buffets.
Spa treatments draw on European, Oriental and Ayurvedic traditions.
The spa has a sauna, steam room and plunge pools.
The hotel's signature Tuk Tuk and Electric Tuk Tuk offer drop-off and pick-up at ICONSIAM.

highlights.text: The hotel offers helicopter transfers via its private helipad.
The hotel's rice-barge-inspired boats connect to the BTS Skytrain, ICONSIAM and selected public piers on request.
The hotel has a three-tiered pool with river and city views.
The Peninsula Spa is in a three-story Thai colonial-style building by the river, with private suites that have steam showers and whirlpools overlooking the Chao Phraya River.
Thiptara serves Thai cuisine overlooking the Chao Phraya River, set among traditional teakwood salas and tropical gardens.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes limited walking access to BTS Skytrain stations; the hotel's boats connect to the BTS Skytrain on request.
A minimum age of 16 is required for spa access and treatments.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
